checks.name: Actual published library passes without gaining an exact target or action claim
Portable personal notes round-trip while their source assignment stays uncertified
Wrong manifest revision and wrong clip bytes are rejected
Unknown clips, unrelated incarnations and duplicate notes cannot enter an import
An import cannot claim certification, combat assignment or add executable fields
Script-like listening text remains plain data with strict field length bounds
Unsafe audio paths and external publisher links fail before any audio request
A failed proposed import leaves existing personal notes intact

scope: Actual library and hostile portable-note documents; positive notes are user reports only, never a canonical source action review.
